definition: Gamma coherence is a measure of how strongly brain activity is synchronized between different regions in the gamma frequency range, here described as about 30–40 Hz. In this study, higher gamma coherence in a frontal–occipital–parietal connection was linked to greater working memory load and was interpreted as reflecting top-down control of ongoing visual processing.
